title: Marketplace listing landing arc + acceptance checklist
body:
Purpose:
This working doc outlines a recommended "story arc" for a cloud marketplace listing (landing experience -> trial activation -> immediate value -> retention), plus a pragmatic acceptance checklist and QA/telemetry hooks. Aim: give small GTM + ENG teams a single-page playbook to get a tile live and measurable with minimal back-and-forth.

Target audience:
- Marketplace PM/Marketing owner
- Partner engineering / integration owner
- Solutions engineering for demo flows
- Product/Legal for entitlements & compliance signoff

Top-level landing story arc (recommended flow)
1) Hook (tile + short headline): capture attention and signal differentiated outcome (cost/latency/compatibility).
2) Quick context (1-line): who this is for and one key capability (e.g., "dedicated inference with predictable latency").
3) Primary value bullets (3): what you can try in 5 minutes and why it matters (e.g., cost controls, rollouts, private deployment).
4) Trial CTA & entitlements: clear trial activation, what resources are provisioned, trial limits, expected timeline.
5) Quickstart: 3-step snippet or link to a one-click deploy / API-key flow.
6) Activation moment: sample API call / quick demo where user sees an inference response within 60s.
7) Retention hook: next-best-step (tutorial, SOC/enterprise doc, contact for Dedicated).

Copy variants (short tiles and short descriptions) - pick one tone for launch A/B tests
- Tile headline A (practical): "Ship predictable LLM inference — hosted, dedicated, private"
- Tile headline B (outcome): "Low-latency LLMs at production scale"
- Short description A: "Start a 14-day trial: deploy hosted inference or try a private VPC. Fast API, cost controls, and SLA-ready tooling."
- Short description B: "Run production-grade LLM inference with predictable latency and built-in rollouts. Try now — credits included."
- Long blurb (1 paragraph): "Redwood Inference provides a unified runtime for LLM serving across hosted, reserved, and private deployments. Onboard in minutes: get API keys, run sample prompts, and evaluate latency and cost with built-in tracing and token-level analytics. Enterprises can request Dedicated capacity or a Private deployment for extra isolation and compliance."

Feature bullet suggestions (for listing bullets)
- Fast API + streaming responses
- Model catalog with verified performance profiles
- Token-level cost and latency analytics
- Canary & A/B rollout support; automatic fallbacks
- Dedicated GPU pools and private VPC options

Trial & entitlement draft lines (to put in listing/features)
- Trial length: 14 days of hosted credits (up to 200,000 generated tokens)
- What’s provisioned: API key, demo model in hosted mode, sample console access; optional on-request Dedicated demo within 3 business days
- Limits & quotas: single-region, 4 concurrent requests default, 1M token cap during trial
- Upgrade path CTA: "Upgrade to Dedicated or Private — contact sales for SLA and regional commitments."

Acceptance checklist (pre-launch gates)
- Copy & assets: tile headline, short desc, long blurb, 3 feature bullets, 2 screenshots, 1 30s demo GIF
- Legal: Marketplace terms mapping verified with legal; trial terms & privacy reviewed
- Billing: SKU mapping configured (trial SKU + paid SKU), metering tags set, marketplace invoice test completed
- Security/compliance: data residency statement added, KMS/HSM integration notes linked, SOC2/ISO snippets available
- Engineering: sample API key works end-to-end, sample request returns < 2s for small prompt, streaming works in tile demo
- Observability: trial activation event and first-response event hooked into telemetry, trial conversions tracked
- Support/Docs: quickstart doc + troubleshooting FAQ in place; escalation playbook and contact email added to listing

QA checklist (run these before clicking "publish")
- Visuals
  - Tile renders on desktop & mobile (no clipping)
  - Short description truncated correctly at platform limit
- Functional
  - API key from marketplace provisioning calls the hosted endpoint and returns signed usage
  - Demo GIF plays and shows expected response
  - Streaming path: partial response arrives within 500ms during a local test
- Billing & SKU
  - Trial SKU logs usage and converts to visible invoice line in test merchant account\  - Licensing tags appear in analytics pipeline
- Entitlement and limits
  - Attempting > quota returns expected HTTP 429 + human-readable error
  - Upgrade flow redirects to contact form or marketplace upgrade path
- Security
  - No PII is surfaced in sample logs; sample telemetry redacts tokens
  - KMS key ID displayed in admin console for Private trial requests

Telemetry events to instrument (suggested names)
- marketplace.trial.requested (payload: account_id, region, sku_id)
- marketplace.trial.provisioned (payload: account_id, api_key_id, model_catalog_preview)
- marketplace.demo.first_response (payload: api_key_id, latency_ms, model)
- marketplace.trial.converted (payload: account_id, invoice_id, commitment_tier)
- marketplace.tile.click (payload: tile_variant, referrer)

A/B test matrix (example)
- Variant 1: Headline A + Demo GIF (measure: trial.requested / tile.click)
- Variant 2: Headline B + Short explainer video (measure: demo.first_response conversion to trial)
- Primary metric: trial.requested / tile_click rate; Secondary: demo.first_response latency and trial.converted within 30 days

Rollback / failure modes & runbook snippets
- If trial provisioning error rate > 5% in first hour: rollback tile to a static "Contact sales" variant and trigger ENG alert (ENG-3456).
- If demo.first_response median latency > 500ms for > 10% of requests: rollback streaming demo and tag as "performance-investigation".
- Marketplace listing takedown: pre-prepared takedown copy and legal notification template in linked_confluence (link in metadata).

Minimal telemetry dashboard (for PM to ask SRE/Observability team)
- Tile click funnel (tile_click -> trial_requested -> trial_provisioned -> demo_first_response)
- Latency distribution (demo_first_response), grouped by region and model
- Trial-to-paid conversion rate by SKU and acquisition channel

Sample JIRA/next-steps tickets (copy to paste)
- MK-789: Create marketplace assets (tile PNGs, 120x120, 2 variants), owner: design, due: +5d
- ENG-3456: End-to-end trial provisioning smoke test & remediation, owner: integrations, due: +3d
- DOC-402: Publish quickstart guide for marketplace trial, owner: docs, due: +4d

Open questions (to resolve in review)
- Trial token cap: is 200k tokens sufficient for typical evaluation use cases? (ops to confirm)
- Private/Dedicated demo: do we want an "on-request" demo or a pre-provisioned Dedicated sandbox?
- Legal: required marketplace language for data retention in APAC regions

Quick next steps for launch owner
1) Pick tile copy variant and GIF (A/B candidates)
2) Confirm SKU mapping with billing (include test merchant id)
3) Run the QA checklist end-to-end in a staging listing environment
4) Book a triage window for first-hour watch with Observability & ENG

Notes to reviewers (brief):
- This is intentionally prescriptive to reduce back-and-forth during listing intake. Keep feedback to concrete rewording, SKU constraints, and any legal/regional requirements.
- If we want a second doc for Dedicated/Private flows (post-trial), I can draft a conversion playbook that includes enterprise SLAs and POC gating criteria.

Revision log:
- 2025-11-03: initial draft by PN
- 2025-11-06: added telemetry event names and QA steps (EM)
- 2025-11-10: updated trial limits after ops feedback (LP)
